newsitem.title: UK: FTSE 100 opens slightly firmer, no real direction.
newsitem.headline: FTSE 100 opens slightly firmer, no real direction.

text.p: The FTSE 100 opened slightly firmer at the start of what is expected to be another directionless trading session, traders said.

"There doesn't seem to be anything to direct this market. I think we'll see some sorting out of stocks ahead of the weekend," said one dealer. "One thing that might possibly give us a lead this morning is the futures market."
At 0735 GMT, the FTSE 100 was up 3.6 points at 3,936.8, but decliners narrowly outnumbered advancers 36 to 33.
In the futures market, the December contract opened at 3,972, up 4.0 points.
